cityClasses.title: Lazy River Floating Soundbath
cityClasses.address: 22343 E Ryan Rd, Queen Creek, AZ 85142
cityClasses.note: Floated in the resort-style lazy river — the current is switched off during the soundbath, so you drift on calm, still water. Booked through the Town of Queen Creek (search "swimming" activities).

cityClasses.title: Witches Regatta SUP Event
cityClasses.note: Our annual Halloween paddleboard gathering on Tempe Town Lake — wear your best witch or warlock cloak and float the lake as a coven. It's wildly popular and capacity is limited, so book early.

cityClasses.title: Salt River Paddleboarding Outing
cityClasses.note: A guided paddleboard outing on the lower Salt River — glide past saguaros, cottonwoods and the wild horses on calm desert water. Best of all, you'll paddle alongside our friendly golden retriever — an introvert's dream and the perfect companion (and conversation starter) on the water. Boards and guide included. Meeting point: the Walgreens at 3624 N Power Rd, Mesa — we head to the river together from there.
